active_resolution.memory_horizon: selected dependency handoff plus direct canonical precedents

sections: Intake record, candidate, approval, and promotion records
schema and artifact-kind source admission precedent
repository-defined registry-brief kind and instance precedent
immutable Charter lineage and exact-result authority to preserve

repo_truth: A nine-path HCM-2.3 planning subject is submitted from exact HCM-2.2 closeout HEAD. Four existing documents contain bounded HCM-2.2 status corrections; five new HCM-2.3 documents contain the proposed specification, plan, todo, decision, and pre-review evidence. No conclusion about adequacy or review status is supplied to the reviewer.
allowed_scope: Remain read-only and replay all nine manifest hashes, sorted order, and aggregate before review.
Review the complete documentation subject against the cited authority, not only the new specification.

Test exact identity, trust, kind/instance separation, generic operations, validation, intake lineage, persistence/currentness/recovery, real product path, compatibility, proof classification, plan executability, and stale-status correction.
Return evidence-backed findings ordered Critical, Required, Optional, Nit, including the smallest authority-preserving repair and missing validation.
non_goals: No edits, staging, commits, handoff/ledger writes, branch changes, preservation-location access, or user task hops.
No Rust, Cargo, runtime tests, production assets, CLI/SDK implementation, HCM-2.2 authority changes, HCM-2.4, Phase 3+, or Phase 4 implementation.
Do not inherit the parent audit or infer success from the pre-review proof wall; derive the result independently.
tasks: Invoke the required skills in order, read AGENTS.md, and return BLOCKED on any manifest or authority mismatch.
Verify the custom registry-brief lineage creates no shipped default and that every source/ref/fingerprint/path/limit/refusal rule is deterministic, local, no-follow, and caller-nonauthoritative.
Verify kind/instance/intake ownership remains acyclic; exact operation IDs and write sets match the canonical table; the HCM-2.3 CLI/owner API proof does not claim the later SDK/transport program.

Adversarially review candidate/approval-null/promotion values, validation-result authority, idempotency/currentness, journal topology, crash recovery, lock order, replay, concurrency, and no-migration semantics for invention gaps or contradictions.
Verify one actual binary path carries kind ref and instance ID as data through registration, canonical-YAML validation, all supplied intake modes, separate appends, promotion, restart, and replay.
Verify the maximum classification change and gate subsets do not close deferred semantic, lifecycle, Projection, SDK, or program-wide work.
Verify the plan is ordered RED/GREEN with live impact gates, proof after each increment, full regression wall, fresh-review remediation loop, change detection, and two-commit implementation closeout.
Return CLEAN only if no Critical, Required, Optional, or Nit finding remains; otherwise return CHANGES_REQUIRED or BLOCKED without repairing.
stop_conditions: Return BLOCKED on any subject-fingerprint, path, source-handoff, or authority-section mismatch.
Return CHANGES_REQUIRED if implementation must invent an identity, closed value, authority edge, operation mapping, refusal, persistence/currentness/recovery rule, test oracle, or Phase 4 boundary.
Return CHANGES_REQUIRED on stale status, unauthorized classification movement, shipped-default mutation, HCM-2.2 reinterpretation, or scope expansion.
Do not waive or repair findings and do not create a global handoff.
